scenarios.name: confetti-on-purchase-button
scenarios.rationale: B matches the rubric on every point: the `npx shadcn@latest add @magicui/confetti` install, a client component, `useRef<ConfettiRef>` passed as `ref`, `manualstart`, and `confettiRef.current?.fire(...)` in onClick. A uses the older URL-based install command instead of the `@magicui/confetti` form and leads with ConfettiButton. Its Option B does cover the ref, `manualstart` and `fire()`, but it calls `fire()` after an async fetch rather than directly in the onClick as the rubric describes.

scenarios.name: fix-outdated-blur-in-and-ticker
scenarios.rationale: A hits every rubric point: it uses the named `Marquee` export, replaces `BlurIn` with `TextAnimate` (`blurInUp`, `by="word"`) or `BlurFade`, says `BlurIn` no longer exists, and installs with `npx shadcn@latest add @magicui/...` while calling `magicui-cli` unmaintained. B gets the named export and the shadcn CLI but installs through URLs rather than the `@magicui/` form. It hedges on whether `BlurIn` was folded into `TextAnimate`, never mentions `BlurFade`, says the CLI is only 'deprecated', and its `blurIn` animation and `@/components/magicui/` import path are likely wrong.

scenarios.name: animated-beam-integration-diagram
scenarios.rationale: Response A meets every rubric item: it gives the shadcn install command, has "use client", uses AnimatedBeam with containerRef/fromRef/toRef via useRef, and sets a relative container; Response B uses a custom framer-motion implementation with no AnimatedBeam, refs, or install command, so it misses nearly everything.
